title: The three 1,433-rune section streams
question: Do three reported 1,433-rune streams produce a distinctive printed-order pairwise arithmetic output?
summary: The best of twelve fixed arithmetic readings has IoC 0.034813. In 465 of 999 shifted controls, the same twelve-way selection scores at least as high.

scope.representation: Koan 2 plus Spirals without F, Cuneiform without F, and Wing and Tree retaining F; explicit & section boundaries.
scope.procedure: Rebuild three 1,433-rune streams; test each pair under add/subtract modulo 29, forward/reverse second stream; choose highest whole-output IoC; repeat full 12-way selection for 999 seeded independent nonzero circular-shift trials.
scope.parameters: Three pairings, four operations each, 1,433 positions, seed 14333301, 999 control trials; ties count as at least observed.
scope.exclusions: Other section combinations, F choices, routes, key offsets, language scores and discovery-wide selection adjustment.

finding: The printed-order best is reverse-subtraction for Koan 2 + Spirals against Cuneiform, IoC 0.03481289. 465 of 999 selected-shift controls tie or exceed the observed score; their median best score is 0.034799.
limitations: This conditional control does not estimate the probability of discovering the 1,433 equality or test all possible ciphers. Independent pair shifts are a reference construction, not a manuscript-generation model.
next_steps: Specify a new operation and independent plaintext success rule before trying further alignments.
